messages:
maya: Heads up — after we switched packages/sdk package.json to "type": "module" CI started failing for the JS SDK tests that exercise the edge runtime. Both Jest and Vitest show import/mock errors.

maya: Quick error: 
```
Error: Cannot use import statement outside a module
 at Runtime.createScriptFromCode (node_modules/jest-runtime/build/index.js:XXX:XX)
 at Object.<anonymous> (packages/sdk/src/__tests__/client.spec.ts:10:1)
```

jonathan: Is this only in the edge harness or all unit tests? Node 18 on CI?

maya: It's specific to the edge-shim tests that dynamically import the SDK bundle. Node 18 on CI. The symptom: when test does `jest.mock('node-fetch')` or `vi.mock('node-fetch')` the mock is ignored and a real request occurs. Works fine when SDK is CJS.

samir: Yep classic CJS<->ESM mocking mismatch. For Jest you can enable ts-jest useESM or use babel-jest to transpile to commonjs. Both change behavior of `jest.mock`.

priya: For Vitest try `--threads=false` and ensure your mock uses the ESM shape: `vi.mock('node-fetch', () => ({ default: vi.fn() }))`. But edge dynamic import and top-level default exports can make resolution treat it as namespace object.

maya: Our current workaround is a CJS shim under tests/shims that requires the ESM module and exports the default as module.exports, then moduleNameMapper points to it. It works but is confusing to contributors and sample apps.

samir: Another pragmatic fix: add a test-only build step that emits CommonJS into dist-test then run tests against that. Keeps local dev mental model simple. Cost: could hide ESM-only runtime issues, so keep an ESM matrix in CI.

jonathan: Also we should document the workaround in the JS SDK README and sample-app README and add an onboarding checklist item. Add a minimal repro repo linked from the README.

ci-bot: CI job #4123: sample-app edge-tests failed (linux x64) — logs attached.

maya: Plan: 1) open issue with minimal repro + CI logs, 2) add README note with temporary shims and NODE_OPTIONS suggestions, 3) prototype test-only cjs build and moduleNameMapper, 4) add onboarding checklist entry.

priya: I'll add the onboarding blurb and update contributor guide. Samir can prototype the test-build.

samir: On it — I'll start with a rollup config that outputs cjs to dist-test and update jest/vitest configs to prefer that in local runs.

maya: Thanks — filing the issue now and linking this thread. :pray:
